## Summary
The verification plane lands as a new `hh-verification` crate — the
claim-ledger substrate that turns what the model *says* into typed,
delegate-authority claims that can never count as evidence; the
`Validator` contract with typed verdicts over kernel-built evidence
bundles; the independent-critic declarations; Γ floors F2–F7 as kernel
constants; and the two reference-harness wirings (local verdicts after
`action.effect.observed`; completion proposal + claim recording on
`stop{completed}` before `lifecycle.run.finished`).

- **`hh-verification`** (new persistent crate, deps
  wire/identity/provenance/ontology/hir/ledger only — CC10):
  - `vocab` — every closed sum the plane owns
    (`ClaimKind`/`SubjectRef`/`ExtractedBy`/`EvidenceClass`/`Severity`/
    `Intervene`/`DetectorKind`/`DecisionPoint` re-use…).
  - `claims` — `Claim`, `AuthoritativeHandle`, `ReconciliationRecord`,
    `SeverityRecord`, `ReconciliationNotice`; `extract` over structured
    finish fields (authority = delegate, confidence `1_000_000`,
    `NoClaimSurface`/`MalformedClaim`/`AuthorityExceedsOrigin`); the
    `bind` kind table; the pure `ledger_only` reconcile fold (a
    `diverge` cites ≥ 1 handle record, never claim text — F7).
  - `evidence` — `EvidenceHandle`, `EvidenceItem`, `EvidenceBundle`,
    `OmissionRecord`, `inputs_digest`; `collect` refuses
    `ClaimOnlyEvidence`/`EvidenceMissing`/`Stale`/`Unauthoritative`/
    `Tampered` (AC-R-2.7.1-3).
  - `validators` — `ValidatorDeclaration` + `declare`/`bind`
    (`ValidatorHasEffects` at bind — AC-R-2.7.1-2; judge ⇒
    ¬deterministic ∧ `profile_ref` ∧ assumption debt — I-V1,
    AC-R-2.7.1-12); `Verdict`/`Finding`; kernel local checks
    (a) `schema_conformance`, (b) `exit_status_class`,
    (c) `patch_application` ((d) `diff_sanity` stays Stage 2 —
    ADR-0111(e), DF-S1.21-1).
  - `critics` — `CriticDeclaration` (OracleDeclaration ∪ critic fields),
    closed `evidence_class`, `IndependenceVector` + per-use minimums,
    `CalibrationRecord`, `grounding` derivation + `consume`
    admissibility (`GroundingInsufficient` — AC-R-2.7.3-1),
    `RedundantJudge` (AC-R-2.7.3-13), the `ProgrammaticCritic`
    contract.
  - `gate` — `ValidatesRecord`, `AcceptanceCriterion`, `TaskContract`,
    `VerificationSummary`, `GateResult`, Γ schema + floors F2–F7 as
    kernel constants; `validate_gamma` refuses loosening
    (`GammaBelowFloor`) and conditioned rows carry assumption-debt
    records (AC-R-2.7.2a-10); `deliver` precondition (`HeldOutLeak`).
  - `events` — canonical payload builders for the eight
    `verification.*` classes; `metrics` — the ADR-0114 D1
    deterministic declaration register (`false_completion_rate` marked
    **veto**; `execution_alignment_failure_rate_judged` /
    `belief_divergence` kept distinct — AC-R-2.7.2a-9).
- **`hh-ledger`** — class registrations: `verification.claim.recorded`,
  `verification.claim.reconciled`, `verification.gate.evaluated`,
  `verification.validator.invoked` (audit-grade), `…validator.verdict`,
  `…completion.proposed`, `…completion.decided`,
  `…artefact.followed` — provenance-mandatory audit rows.
- **`hh-ontology`** — `reconciliation.holds` dimension (gauge).
- **`hh-registry`** — `validator` `ClassRecord` (ordered-many;
  `required_inputs ⊇ {ModelProfile, ResourceAccount}` —
  AC-R-2.7.1-11) + `execution_alignment` registered **floors-only** (no
  C0 variant bound — its variant is C2's; the corpus generator excludes
  floors-only classes rather than fabricating variants).
- **`hh-telemetry`** — the ADR-0114 D1 metric declarations registered;
  two provisional `computed_from` spellings corrected.
- **`hh-env::dispatch`** — after appending `action.effect.observed`,
  builds a `TerminalCapture` from the same terminal report and appends
  `verification.validator.verdict` rows (`phase = local`,
  `detector = deterministic`, `charged_to = subject`, `inputs_digest`,
  provenance) under `hir/kernel/local_checks@1`. The observation row is
  appended first and never mutated (AC-R-2.7.1-1/-2).
- **`hh-control::driver`** — `EffectGate::finish_record` (additive
  defaulted method); on `StopReason::Completed`, `finish` emits
  `verification.completion.proposed` + `verification.claim.recorded`
  (kind ∈ {achieved, unachievable}, criteria status aligned, delegate
  model provenance, `model_call_id`/`run_id` carried) **before** drain
  assessment and `lifecycle.run.finished` (AC-R-2.7.2a-1).

## Decisions
**ADR-0257** — the `hh-verification` plane crate; claims as
delegate-authority `claimed` observations; the `finish_record`
completion seam; the verify placement in dispatch; Γ floors as
constants; floors-only `execution_alignment` registration;
`RedundantJudge`/grounding as declaration-level checks; the D1 metric
declarations.
